name: Glute Bridge
description: Raise the hips from a bent-knee lying position to train hip extension.

items.content: Lie on the back with feet flat and hip-width apart; keep knees aligned with the feet.
Brace gently and push through the feet to lift the hips.
Squeeze the glutes and stop when shoulders, hips and knees form a line; avoid arching the back.
Keep the neck relaxed and lower the pelvis with control.

stages.name: Start
stages.description: Lying on the back with knees bent, feet flat and hip-width apart, and arms resting beside the body.

stages.name: Top
stages.description: Shoulders and feet on the floor, hips raised into a straight line with shoulders and knees. Knees remain aligned with feet and arms rest beside the body.
